title: Analysis code for: Single-molecule stoichiometry by direct RNA sequencing distinguishes epitranscriptome remodeling from artifacts in kidney ischemia–reperfusion injury
description: Figure-generation and analysis code (R/Python/Bash) for a five-group time course of mouse kidney ischemia–reperfusion injury profiled by Oxford Nanopore direct RNA sequencing, matched RNA-seq, ATAC-seq and untargeted metabolomics. Companion datasets: NGDC GSA (BioProject PRJCA079331, submission subCRA087106), NGDC OMIX (OMIX023403), GEO (GSE274819).
